about.title: About TX Roofing & Services
text: At TX Roofing, we provide high-quality roofing solutions for residential and commercial properties throughout Houston and surrounding areas. Built on a foundation of craftsmanship, integrity, and reliability, we are committed to delivering roofs that stand the test of time.
Whether it’s a roof repair, full roof replacement, storm damage restoration, or new installation, our team combines quality materials with expert workmanship to ensure lasting protection and value.

Led by CEO Victor Penalver, our team of certified roofing professionals delivers expert roof replacements, honest roof repairs, and reliable storm damage restoration for homeowners across Houston and surrounding areas. With 500+ roofs completed and over a decade of experience, we don’t just fix roofs — we deliver peace of mind.

areasText: TX Roofing and Services works with homeowners and businesses across Houston and the surrounding Greater Houston area, from its Houston shop on Mangum Rd and its Sugar Land office.

materials.title: Manufacturer Certified
materials.text: Roofs are built with premium Owens Corning and IKO materials, backed by warranties you can count on.

facts.heading: Free Roof Inspection
facts.text: Free, no-obligation roof inspections across the Greater Houston area. An online roof estimator also gives a personalized cost estimate in about 60 seconds with no sign-up and no sales calls.

facts.heading: Financing
facts.text: Flexible financing with fast approvals and $0 down options available. The online financing calculator estimates a monthly payment and checks eligibility in under a minute with no impact to your credit score. TX Roofing and Services is not a lender and does not originate loans.

facts.heading: Insurance Claims
facts.text: Full insurance claim support, from the free inspection through to the claim itself, for storm and hail damage.

facts.heading: Emergency Response
facts.text: 24/7 emergency response, open Monday to Sunday.

facts.heading: Certifications
facts.text: Google Guaranteed roofer, manufacturer certified, and installing premium Owens Corning and IKO materials with warranty-backed workmanship.

facts.heading: Leadership
facts.text: TX Roofing and Services is led by CEO Victor Penalver.
